mainEntity.name: What is the College Sub Shop's address?

acceptedAnswer.text: College Sub Shop is located at 6150 El Cajon Blvd, San Diego, CA 92115, USA. This is where you will go to get DoorDash Pickup orders, and where Dashers will go to get your DoorDash delivery orders.

mainEntity.name: Does College Sub Shop offer delivery or pickup?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can browse College Sub Shop’s menu and place an order for both Delivery and Pickup on DoorDash. College Sub Shop may also offer delivery and pickup on their own or through other delivery services.

mainEntity.name: Is College Sub Shop a DashPass eligible store?

acceptedAnswer.text: College Sub Shop is not a DashPass eligible store. You can use the ‘DashPass’ filter on the homepage to find stores on DoorDash that offer DashPass benefits like $0 delivery, reduced service fees, and $5 credits back on Pickup orders. You can also look for the DashPass icon next to the store’s name.
